what: A toy crowd drawn with three.js behind the panel — capsule bodies, ball heads and stick limbs with dark ink outlines (inverted shell .05), three-step cartoon shading and a round shadow under the feet (1.32 · .17). 48 people (26 below 820px) walk around a floor of radius 27 (1.05~1.65/s, pushed apart when within 1.55 of each other, turning at 7.5rad per second), 12% stop and stand for 2~6.5 seconds and 30% meet a neighbor within 7 and chat face to face for 7~26 seconds. Every 2.4~5.2 seconds a coin rises 3.6 above a head for 1.45 seconds, spinning. At the world’s edge (0,−26) stand a giant’s two legs 48 high (trouser radius 4.6 · shoe length 13.8, one foot forward) that sway .009rad at .21Hz and shift weight over 1.8 seconds every 6~13 seconds. Speech bubbles (DOM) number up to six, floating 2.2~3.6 seconds above people who are chatting (turn on in .14s, one in seven is a red shout). The camera cycles on a 16-second period between far (distance 64 · height 35) and near (13 · 4.4) while rotating .08rad per second, and looks at one person’s head height .72 when near and at the middle of the crowd when far (focus follows with 1−e easing). Firing fx:play moves it to the play viewpoint (0,43,54 → 0,2,−3) in 1.5 seconds. On narrow portrait screens the field of view widens from 34° to 58° to keep a reference width of 1.4 aspect.

options.count · count-narrow: Number of people, default 48 · 26 below 820px board width
options.fov: Vertical field of view (°), default 34 — narrow screens widen it to 58
options.handover: fx:play duration (sec) for moving on to the play moment afterward, default 1.5
options.radius: Radius of the floor where people walk, default 27
options.noticed: Number of people who start out already tinted in the accent color with heads raised, default 2
options.lines · shouts: Speech bubble lines (split by |) · red shouting line
options.giant · coins: If off, drops the giant legs and coins
options.[data-fx-part=bubbles]: (if present) speech bubble layer — if absent it is created and attached. 17 bubbles are built once and reused
options.fx:play · fx:title: Event fired at the element — jump to the play phase · back to the Hero orbit
options.fx:ready: Once the first frame paints, the element fires — a signal to lift the loading curtain
options.fx:restart: Fire at the element to restart the hero orbit count from the beginning (far away, in the middle of the crowd) — when the loading curtain lifts

use: — Load three.cjs first as window.THREE
note: Colors are read from the skin — floor·sky --kf-bg, body white, outline·eyes --kf-ink, hat·black shirt --kf-ink-soft, the person who notices --kf-accent, the shout --kf-danger. People·giant·coins are basic shapes with the same silhouette proportions instead of the original glb. With reduced motion, the person stands still and only one frame is drawn. Not drawn when the stage is off-screen

from.where: index.html .dl-stage (live scene behind the hero — original CONFIG.crowd·social·giant·coins·intro·camera values, play viewpoint is camera.position·target)
